ItemID: 1; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Truss Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Cross Recessed Truss Head Machine Screws, Phillips Drive, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3T; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These could complement my UNC rivet nuts for fastening panels, provided the thread and length match.
ItemID: 2; Title: M8 (100 pcs) Stainless Steel Flat Washers, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8 Plain Washers, Narrow Type, DIN125A; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful alongside my metric hardware for spreading clamping pressure on mounting projects.
ItemID: 3; Title: Official Creality Ender 3 Pro 3D Printer with Removable Build Surface Plate and Branded Power Supply, FDM 3D Printers for DIY Home and School Printing Size 8.66x8.66x9.84 inch; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current projects center on assembly and repairs; I do not have a specific printing project in mind.
ItemID: 4; Title: TRONXY Carbon Fiber Filament 1.75mm, Carbon Fiber PLA 3D Printer Filament, High-Accuracy +/- 0.05 mm, Carbon Black Pla Filament for Most 3D Printers, 1KG Spool(2.2 lbs); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no established need for printer filament or evidence that it fits equipment I own.
ItemID: 5; Title: toolant Four Spiral Flute Step Drill Bit Set (Pro), 1/8"-7/8"(3pcs) Impact Ready Advanced High Speed Steel Unibit Step Bit, 1/4" Hex Shank Unibit for Metal, Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Wood, Plastic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Step bits would complement my cobalt drill set for enlarging holes in sheet material for rivets and mounting hardware.
ItemID: 6; Title: M5-0.8 x 30mm (30 pcs) Flanged Button Socket Head Cap Screws, 304 Stainless Steel, Full Thread, ISO7380-2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These fit my interest in metric assembly hardware, and the flanged heads could be useful for mounting brackets.
ItemID: 7; Title: #14 x 3/4" Pan Head Self Drilling Screws, 410 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Pan Head Self Drilling Screws with Tapping Screw Thread, 30 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Self-drilling screws offer a useful fastening option for sheet-metal repair projects.
ItemID: 8; Title: Clutch Tension Straps (20" 2-Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title does not establish a use that connects clearly to my current projects.
ItemID: 9; Title: M3-0.5 (100 Pcs) Acorn Cap Nut, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Hex Drive, Hex Dome Head Cap Nut, DIN1587; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Capping exposed small bolts could be useful, but I would skip a hundred-piece pack without a specific need.
ItemID: 10; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Disposable gloves could help with messy work, but I would check chemical compatibility before choosing them for resin use.
